property_summary: For every successful CashOut call, the recipient contract must observe the same calldata length as the reference implementation (zero bytes), because the reference performs the low-level call with empty calldata; the mutant sends a one-byte 0x00 payload, so the recipient records a nonzero calldata length and breaks the rule.
change_summary: Replace the empty-string value for the external call with `0x00`, changing the call data so a contract recipient behaves differently and may revert.
